text:
Maya Patel: heads-up — saw a spike in unowned leads after the hs enrichment lag this morning, ~900 in the dead-letter queue. owner null in logs.
Josh Kim: ugh. is this the 45s claim timeout we tweaked? `claim_timeout=45s owner=null`
Maya Patel: I think so. pattern: enrichment webhook delayed -> hubspot event arrives -> round-robin runs but affinity not respected, so many go into overflow.
Emilia Cruz: can we try an affinity-first patch for the next 30m window? keep RR as fallback. reduces churn for reps. :thinking_face:
Luca Romano: yep we can flip a flag server-side. quick config I sketched:
```
route_strategy: affinity_first
affinity_ttl_seconds: 300
fallback_strategy: round_robin
```
Maya Patel: perfect. want to limit to leads with enrichment score >= 0.6 so we don't bias low-quality leads.
Luca Romano: good call. will add gating on `enrich_score >= 0.6`. making the change in staging now, will smoke test with replay.
leadbot: deploy started by @luca on staging (build #289). status: running checks. :gear:
Josh Kim: if staging looks good, can we run a small canary on EMEA queue for 10m? watch claim success rate and owner hold time.
Emilia Cruz: i'll notify SDR rota and pause any manual claim interventions. also will post a short runbook: what to do if you see duplicate owners.
Luca Romano: staging checks passed. canary scheduled for 10:10 UTC on EMEA queue. metrics to watch: `claim_latency_ms`, `owner_hold_rate`, `dead_letter_count`. i'll post results in 10m.
Maya Patel: thanks — if canary drops dead letters by ~70% we'll roll for 60m then global. otherwise rollback.
Josh Kim: timeline sounds good. tagging @sales-ops to stand by.
Emilia Cruz: noted. updating the handoff playbook with the affinity config and gating rule. will attach a simple rollback snippet too.
Luca Romano: rollback snippet: `route_strategy=round_robin; affinity_ttl_seconds=0;`
leadbot: canary finished. results: dead_letter_count down 72% in EMEA, claim_latency up ~8% but within SLO.
Maya Patel: love it. schedule the 60m roll and i'll run a quick seg analysis to ensure no geo bias.
Josh Kim: once global, let's add a follow-up alert to notify when affinity hit-rate < 50% so we don't silently regress.
Emilia Cruz: added to Ops checklist. will send a one-paragraph note to sales leadership after global roll. :rocket:
